scene: a wide shallow bowl of pale green soup on a scratched steel kitchen bench, a heavy swirl of black pepper across the middle and a thread of oil at the rim, the enamel pan behind with its lid tipped against the wall tiles, a wooden spoon laid on a folded square of kitchen paper, one bare bulb overhead and a dark window beyond

the far wall of a college hall hung with unframed student drawings pinned at the corners, uneven spacing, one sheet curling away from the wall, a folding table at the edge of frame with plastic cups and a stack of photocopied sheets, scuffed parquet floor and high grey daylight from clerestory windows

a three layer sponge cake on a chipped white plate on a small kitchen table, visibly leaning to one side, buttercream squeezing out between the top two layers, one stub of a birthday candle pushed in off centre with old wax down its side, crumbs and a bread knife on greaseproof paper beside it, warm lamp light from the left

a bunch of yellow spring flowers crammed into a jam jar with the label half soaked off, standing on a windowsill in a north facing flat, the paper sleeve they came in folded flat under the jar, water clouded and a fallen petal beside it, cold flat daylight and the shape of a chimney stack beyond the glass

a long official application form opened flat on a kitchen table, printed in two colours on stiff paper with dense boxed sections and a fold crease down the middle, a ballpoint pen laid diagonally across the untouched third page, a mug ring on the corner of the sheet and a torn envelope pushed away to the edge, evening lamp from above

a bare-limbed tree in full white blossom leaning over a canal towpath, still black water below holding an upside down copy of it, a low iron railing and a mooring ring, brick wall and gravel path in the foreground, thin bright overcast light with no shadows

a kitchen table covered end to end with school paperwork, a printed class list four pages long fanned out with rows ticked off in two different pens, a yellow highlighter uncapped and lying on its side, a closed laptop pushed to the back with a mug on top of it, a cold half drunk cup and a plate with crumbs, hard overhead kitchen light

a hospital car park at eight in the morning in early spring, low sun coming straight down the rows and throwing long shadows off the barrier posts, wet tarmac drying in patches, one lamp still lit on its column, a strip of grass with frost only in the shade and the hill and rooftops beyond the fence
